caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a rectangular backrest and seat, both covered in brown leather that is secured with brass tacks along the edges. The leather on the backrest is decorated with embossed, symmetrical floral or star-like patterns. The legs and the frame of the chair are made of wood with a grayish-brown color and visible grain. The chair’s legs are straight and connected by horizontal wooden stretchers near the bottom, while the stretchers on the sides feature a scalloped design. The artwork is set against a plain, light beige background without any additional objects or elements. There is a small inscription of the artist’s name near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Chair
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
